metadata.tagline: Set a budget. Stop the bleeding before you see the bill.
metadata.one_liner: Real-time token budget enforcement and cascade prevention for multi-agent AI systems.
metadata.audience: Enterprise buyers, PMs, CTOs managing agentic AI spend

problem_statement.headline: Your AI agents are burning money and nobody knows how much.
pain_points: Teams cannot see cost-per-task for agentic AI workflows
Leaders make blunt decisions (downgrade everyone) instead of surgical ones (cap the expensive tasks)
A single agentic coding task can consume 1–3.5 million tokens ($30–$105) without warning
Recursive delegation loops compound costs exponentially — 5 agents × 500 iterations = $375 wasted
No visibility = no governance = surprise bills or over-restriction that kills productivity

market_data.multiplier: Agentic systems consume 5–30x more tokens than standard chat

solution.headline: CascadeGuard: The circuit breaker for AI agent spend.
solution.description: CascadeGuard sits between your agents and their delegations. It monitors token consumption in real time, enforces per-agent and system-wide budgets, detects recursive loops before they compound, and provides a full audit trail of every decision — all in under 250 microseconds per check.

four_pillars.name: Cycle Detection
four_pillars.headline: Stops infinite loops before they start.
four_pillars.description: Union-Find algorithm detects circular delegation chains in O(α(N)) — effectively constant time. No agent can delegate back to its ancestor.
four_pillars.metric: <5ms detection, zero false positives on legitimate chains

four_pillars.name: Token Budget
four_pillars.headline: Per-agent and system-wide cost ceilings.
four_pillars.description: Set a token budget per agent or for the entire system. CascadeGuard tracks consumption in real time and blocks delegations when the budget is exhausted. No more surprise bills.
four_pillars.metric: Hard stop at budget limit. Per-task cost attribution in every response.

four_pillars.name: Circuit Breaker
four_pillars.headline: Automatic shutdown when things go wrong.
four_pillars.description: κ_effective (metabolic fuse) monitors delegation velocity, depth, fanout, concentration, and token pressure. When the system is overheating, CascadeGuard enters PRESERVATION mode — all delegations blocked until conditions stabilize.
four_pillars.metric: 5 impedance signals. 4 flow states (Nominal → Elevated → Throttled → Preservation).

four_pillars.name: Audit Trail
four_pillars.headline: Every decision logged. Every dollar accounted for.
four_pillars.description: Every delegation attempt (allowed or blocked) is recorded with timestamp, source, target, reason, κ_effective, tokens consumed, and estimated cost. Ready for compliance review.
four_pillars.metric: 100% decision capture. FERC/CFTC/EU AI Act ready.

demo_scenario.title: The Tuesday Morning Demo
demo_scenario.setup: Set system budget to 500,000 tokens ($15 at $0.03/1K). Register 3 agents.
demo_scenario.punchline: Without CascadeGuard, that coding task runs. And the next one. And the next. By end of day: $400 spent, nobody knew.

competitive_positioning.vs_openai_dashboard: OpenAI shows org-level spend after the fact. CascadeGuard enforces per-task budgets in real time before the tokens are consumed.
competitive_positioning.vs_manual_downgrade: Downgrading everyone to a cheaper tier kills productivity for simple tasks. CascadeGuard lets power users keep Pro access while capping the expensive workflows.
competitive_positioning.vs_rate_limiting: Rate limits cap requests per minute. CascadeGuard caps total cost per task/agent/system — regardless of how fast or slow the requests come.
competitive_positioning.vs_nothing: Without governance, a single recursive loop can burn $375 in minutes. CascadeGuard stops it at iteration 1.

pricing_context.roi_example: If CascadeGuard prevents one runaway cascade per week ($375 saved), it pays for itself in under 3 months at the lowest tier.

technical_specs.dependencies: pydantic (models only). Zero external runtime dependencies.

token_budget_features.per_agent_budget: Set max tokens per agent. Blocked when exceeded.
token_budget_features.system_wide_budget: Set total token ceiling. Hard stop when exhausted.
token_budget_features.cost_attribution: Every verdict includes estimated cost ($). Per-agent usage reports.
token_budget_features.record_tokens: Track consumption during task execution, not just delegation.
token_budget_features.realistic_simulation: Demo randomizes tokens based on real agentic workload data (5K–3.5M per task).

call_to_action.demo: Run the interactive demo: streamlit run cascade-guard/demo/app.py
call_to_action.contact: Interested in how this maps to your team's AI spend? Let's connect.

visual_assets.ai_image_prompt: Minimalist icon set, 4 icons in a horizontal row on dark charcoal background (#1a1a2e). Thin white line-art style, 2px stroke, with green (#76b900) accent highlights. Icons left to right: (1) circular arrow with a diagonal slash breaking the loop, (2) dollar coin inside a semicircular gauge meter with needle near red, (3) lightning bolt stopped by a horizontal circuit breaker bar, (4) clipboard with checkmark and small timestamp lines. Small caps labels below each: CYCLES, BUDGET, BREAKER, AUDIT. Clean, enterprise, no gradients. 16:9 aspect ratio.
